description: For a quiz question of a lesson: says whether the answer is right, which option is, and why. For an exercise: gives its hint and its reference answer to compare the learner’s attempt with (this server does not grade free text and never runs code); offer the hint first and the reference only after a try.

answer.description: The learner’s answer: for the quiz the option’s text or its number (1 to 3); for an exercise optional

kind.description: A quiz question or an exercise

lang.description: The language of the answer: en (the default), pl; es, pt, fr, de, ja and ko for patterns and lessons (the course stays in English there)

number.description: Its number in the lesson, from 1

pattern.description: The pattern (its slug), as list_patterns gives it

name: check_answer
title: Check an answer
